info.title: NOXH Open Platform
info.description: BDSG Foundation MIT. Versioned preparation, reviewed legal source guidance, DVC handoff with unverified citizen-reported receipts, optional bounded OpenAI proposals, investor-managed partners and campaigns, scoped consultant access. Official submission and automatic DVC synchronization unavailable.

get.description: Published non-archived projects in configured organization; explicit development fixture fallback only when DB is not configured.

post.description: Blocked placeholder; no token accepted or session issued. Sprint 2 integrates trusted server verification.
Requires configured approved Zalo template. Five minute OTP, 60s cooldown, max five/hour/phone. Provider failure issues no session.
Single use, five attempts, proof bound to requesting browser. Phone access is not legal identity verification.
Idempotent draft per account/project; owner comes exclusively from server session. No official submission.

patch.description: Whole declaration replacement; partial drafts allowed. Immutable encrypted versions, server owner scope, conflict returns 409.

post.description: Persists deterministic generic preparation assessment bound to current input version. Not legal eligibility. Max 45 while document/form integration unavailable.

get.description: Latest 200 citizen-shared requests in server organization. No access to private declarations.
Validates chain since v0.3; latest 100 events; refuses complete validation over 10000. Not externally checkpointed.
Downloads an exact-page PDF only if its SHA-256 matches the source catalog.

post.description: Requires signed form_legal_approver and a different subject from the author; dates, source hash and immutable payload checked.

put.description: Encrypted server-side key; deployment flag and organization opt-in required; never returns key.

post.description: Per-request consent; saved declaration excluded unless separately opted in. Bounded Responses API function tools prepare proposals; do not execute writes.
Explicit owner confirmation, input version, expiry, single consumption, write and audit in one transaction.

get.description: Verified phone session plus active server-side partner membership; roles and project grants come only from database.

put.description: Role, agency, active project and expected version checked. Project cannot change; editing content resets investor approval.

get.description: Consultants see assigned leads only; managers see agency-consented contacts only within active project grants.

post.description: Separate consent to named agency. Contact comes from authenticated verified phone account; dossier and documents never shared.

delete.description: Removes encrypted shared contact and records withdrawal atomically; agency API can no longer retrieve the lead.

challengeProof.description: BFF stores in HttpOnly cookie; never returned to browser JS

sessionToken.description: Opaque bearer, BFF stores only in HttpOnly cookie

projectId.description: Assigned project. Immutable after creation; create a new campaign for a different project. Existing consultation consent cannot be transferred.

WorkforceBearer.bearerFormat: JWT RS256, Keycloak AMR otp, org_admin
